generation: One original transparent 1254 × 1254 atlas. Quadrants were cropped into four individual sprites. The original output was generated for this project without reference-image inputs.
prompt: A 2 by 2 uniform game asset atlas, square canvas transparent background, four fully isolated independent sprites, each within its own square quadrant with at least 12% empty bleed on each quadrant edge. Luxurious richly detailed illustrated 1990s pixel art for a Vietnamese folklore side-scrolling platformer, nighttime, cool teal shadow but richly warm highlighted wood/amber lanterns, strong clean readable silhouette. FRONT SIDE ELEVATION strictly orthographic. Upper left quadrant: beautifully crafted Vietnamese bamboo village entrance gate, roof thatched with gold straw, two red silk lanterns hanging left and right, clear open space underneath for an adventurer to pass through, no writing. Upper right quadrant: single traditional Vietnamese thatched rural cottage in side view with a tall triangular sweeping rice-straw roof, bamboo slat siding, warmly glowing tiny window, door, slight greenery. Lower left quadrant: traditional dark timber Vietnamese sampan fishing boat in side view, one arched woven bamboo roof, vertical pole hanging one glowing red lantern, pointed upturned bow right. Lower right quadrant: beautiful ancient Vietnamese banyan tree as a silhouette asset, very wide crown, braided trunk, dangling aerial roots and moss with blue moonlit rim. No text, no letters, no humans, no numbers, no guidelines, no printed checkerboard. Items should be centered in each quadrant, separate from other sprites, all fully visible not cut off. Transparent background with actual alpha. The hanging lanterns are warmly lit, edges clear, figurative premium game art similar to lush storybook-pixel style. All lighting contained within each prop, no cast shadow on transparent space.
cropConvention: Coordinates are [x, y, width, height] in pixels from top left of the source atlas.
